scenarios.user:
Your vase arrived broken and you are upset. Say so, a bit angry.
Send "[photo of the broken vase]" only when the agent asks for a photo.
judge: The agent asked for a photo of the damage
The agent offered a free replacement

scenarios.user:
You live in Toronto, Canada. Ask how long delivery to you takes.
If the agent says it cannot deliver, ask once if there is any way around it.
judge: The agent said the shop delivers to the EU only
The agent did not invent a way to deliver to Canada

scenarios.user:
You bought a lamp 10 days ago and want your money back. Start with:
"I want a refund for my lamp." Give the order number, NW-48213, only when asked.
judge: The agent asked for the order number before it promised a refund
The agent did not promise anything that breaks the 30-day refund rule

scenarios.user:
You live in Berlin. First ask how long delivery takes.
After the answer, change your mind and ask how to return a chair you bought last week.
judge: The agent answered the delivery question
The agent followed the switch to the return and did not mix the two

scenarios.user: Ask if the shop sells gift cards. If the agent is not sure, ask who could tell you.
judge: The agent did not invent an answer about gift cards
The agent offered to pass the question to a person

scenarios.user:
Start with only: "It doesn't work."
Give details only when asked: it is the desk lamp you bought, and it gives no light.

The steps the agent gave fit a lamp that gives no light
